summary: Relic-Map is an immersive, tap-to-learn interactive web application that transforms abandoned NASA space hardware such as the Apollo descent stages, stranded Martian rovers, and deep-space probes into an explorable cosmic museum for school-age space enthusiasts. Instead of reading dry textbooks, users navigate a 3D holographic solar system map and tap on landing beacons to inspect historical spacecraft through interactive 3D exploded views and time-travel wear sliders. By exploring how dust storms blocked solar panels or how distant radio signals faded, students uncover the engineering triumphs and monumental scientific discoveries enabled by each silent pioneer. Relic-Map bridges space archaeology and interactive education, making NASA's legacy engaging and accessible to the next generation of explorers.
details:
What it does & How it works: Relic-Map is an immersive, tap-to-learn web application designed for school-age space enthusiasts to explore NASA’s abandoned space hardware across the solar system. It operates through three core interactive modules:

  1. The Holographic Planet-Scan Map: A rotating 3D planetary globe (Moon and Mars) where users tap glowing "Ghost Beacons" marking historical landing sites like Tranquility Base or Gale Crater.
  2. The X-Ray Artifact Console: An interactive 3D model viewer where users pull apart spacecraft components using a "Dissect Slider" and tap pulsing nodes on solar panels, drills, and antennas to inspect how they worked and why they went silent.
  3. The Time-Traveler Weather & Wear Slider: A timeline scrubber that lets users drag from "Landing Day" to "Final Transmission" to watch solar panels accumulate dust, paint fade from radiation, and tracks fill with sand in real time.

Benefits & Intended Impact: Relic-Map bridges space archaeology and education by transforming dry historical records into tactile, gamified storytelling. Its intended impact is to spark early STEM curiosity among students, making complex engineering principles (like telemetry decay, power management, and planetary geology) immediately intuitive and engaging.

Development Tools, Languages & Software:

  • Frontend Framework: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS
  • 3D & Visual Rendering: Three.js / Model-Viewer for interactive spacecraft models and vector animations
  • Data & Styling: Custom JSON historical logs, JetBrains Mono typography, and dark-mode aerospace UI components

Creativity & Design Considerations: Rather than presenting abandoned hardware as static "space junk," Relic-Map treats them as heroic robotic pioneers with dramatic operational lifespans. Our team prioritized a low-stimulation, high-immersion dark-mode aesthetic (obsidian canvas, telemetry cyan nodes, and monospace coordinates) to mimic an authentic mission-control terminal while keeping the mobile touch layout clean, fast, and accessible for young learners.
